name: @jarvis/ddns
description: Dynamic-DNS + remote-access foundation: pluggable DdnsProvider impls (Cloudflare / DuckDNS / dyndns2 / Aliyun / DNSPod), public+LAN IP discovery, best-effort UPnP IGD port-mapping (zero-dep SSDP+SOAP), and DdnsRuntime (periodic updater + 0600-persisted config). Consumed by @jarvis/tools + @jarvis/server; runtime-independent.
